sources.entry: Slate - Scriptable window manager configured with JavaScript. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/jigish/slate)
Slate - Slate is a window management application similar to Divvy and SizeUp

summary.one_liner: Slate is a free, highly configurable window manager for macOS that binds keystrokes to move, resize, focus, and snapshot windows.
summary.what_it_does: Slate runs on Mac OS X 10.6 and above and is configured through a ".slate" text file in the home directory, or a ".slate.js" JavaScript file. Keyboard bindings can move or resize windows, push them to screen edges, nudge them, throw them to other screens, and place them in corners or grids. It can focus windows by direction or by application, and show Window Hints overlays that let you pick a window by letter. Preset layouts can arrange several apps at once, and defaults can be tied to monitor configurations so a layout activates when that setup is detected. Snapshots of window positions can be saved, activated, and deleted, and an undo binding reverts recent movements. A beta application switcher can replace the macOS cmd-tab switcher.
use_cases: Snap windows to halves or corners with keyboard shortcuts
Restore a saved arrangement of windows
Switch focus between windows by direction or letter hints
Auto-arrange apps when a monitor is connected
Send windows to a second monitor with a hotkey
how_to_run: Enable Accessibility: System Preferences > Universal Access > Enable access for assistive devices
Download the .dmg or .tar.gz from the project's releases
Or run in terminal: cd /Applications && curl | tar -xz (URL missing from README text)
Create a ~/.slate file (or ~/.slate.js) with config, alias, layout, default, bind, and source directives
Launch Slate and use the status menu to reload the config
notable: Configurable via a plain-text directive file with expressions for sizes and positions
Window Hints overlays for choosing a window by key
Modal key bindings and chained or sequenced operations
caveats: Requires enabling the macOS Accessibility API manually
Setup is described by the README as daunting, with a configuration syntax to learn
Bindings on cmd-tab or cmd-shift-tab disable the default macOS app switcher; Mac spaces/mission control shortcuts can override Slate bindings
The application switcher is marked Beta
